Title: Create New Forum Workflow
Description: Steps to create a new forum with specific name, title, description, and sidebar content.
- Navigate to the 'Forums' section via the 'Forums' link.
- Click the 'Create forum' link to open the creation form.
- Fill the 'Name' textbox with the desired forum name (e.g., 'Cyberpunk').
- Fill the 'Title' textbox with the desired forum title.
- Fill the 'Description' textbox with the required description text.
- Fill the 'Sidebar' textbox with the list items (e.g., using newline-separated values like '- Games\n- Books...').
- Click the 'Create forum' button to submit and finalize the creation.

Title: Forum Creation Field Requirements
Description: Key observations about required fields and input formats for the forum creation page.
- The 'Name' field is required and marked as such in the textbox label.
- The 'Title' field is required and must be filled before proceeding to Description.
- The 'Description' field is required and includes a help text attribute.
- The 'Sidebar' field is required and accepts text input for list items.
- Sidebar content should be entered as a newline-separated list (e.g., '- Item1\n- Item2').
- All four fields (Name, Title, Description, Sidebar) must be completed to enable the submit button.
